feeds.title: The Essential Herbal Blog
feeds.description: The Essential Herbal Blog is filled with information, recipes, lore, and crafting ideas and instructions for using herbs and making them a part of your life everyday. The Essential Herbal Magazine is a print magazine by, for, and about herbie people and the things they love about herbs.

feeds.title: Herbal Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Herbal Academy collaborates with a diversity of herbalists to create an online herbal school that presents many herbal traditions and points of view. Short posts covering all things herby, from nutritional recipes to medicinal herbs.

feeds.title: Growing Up Herbal Blog
feeds.description: I'm Meagan, a registered nurse turned herbalist. Growing Up Herbal is a lifestyle blog about living life naturally. It features herbal remedies, natural skin care recipes, real food recipes, non-toxic living.

feeds.title: Science Based Medicine Blog » Herbs And Supplements
feeds.description: Science Based Medicine is dedicated to evaluating medical treatments and products of interest to the public in a scientific light, and promoting the highest standards and traditions of science in health care. We are a group blog exploring issues and controversies in the relationship between science and medicine.

feeds.title: CommonWealth Holistic Herbalism Blog
feeds.description: We've worked to develop a well-rounded view of herbalism that integrates modern scientific insight and traditional herbal wisdom. It's also important to us to investigate more than just plants: we wanted to incorporate a full-circle perspective of how food, sleep, stress management, and physical movement impact health and wellness, and how they can be integrated into herbal practice to create a truly holistic view of individual health.

feeds.title: Jammu and Kashmir Medicinal Plants Introduction Centre
feeds.description: The Jammu and Kashmir Medicinal Plants Introduction Centre-JKMPIC is a pioneer institution to start the cultivation of important indigenous medicinal plants and introduce many from other parts of the world. A preliminary study on the cultivation of medicinal plants in Jammu and Kashmir was from this institution. Subsequently, a lot of work on cultivation and improvement was done on selected plants by different scientists and a consolidated account of cultivation and utilization of these plants was published

feeds.title: Chestnut School of Herbal Medicine Blog
feeds.description: The Chestnut School of Herbal Medicine located in the botanically rich Appalachian Mountains, just outside of Asheville, North Carolina offers online herbal education on Medicine Making, Foraging, and growing Medicinal Herbs. Blog topics include herbal remedies, growing herbs, foraging healing plants, food as medicine, botany, & more.

feeds.title: KPC Products Blog
feeds.description: KPC Products produces the highest quality of Chinese herbal products and alternative herbal medicine. KPC aims to promote Chinese traditional herbs for a healthier lifestyle and elevate standards of living by distributing the safest and highest quality products.

feeds.title: The Herb Society of America Blog
feeds.description: The Herb Society of America is dedicated to promoting the knowledge, use and delight of herbs through educational programs, research, and sharing the experience of its members with the community. This blog will also help you to learn about how to create and maintain herb gardens, so to get more knowledge subscribe with us.

feeds.title: Botanica Medica Blog
feeds.description: Botanica Medica is a traditional herbal apothecary providing professional herbal medicine individually tailored to your unique needs. We provide information on our herb walks and lovely herbal recipes to make at home and the latest scientific research into plant medicines.

feeds.title: Herbal Musings
feeds.description: Hi my name is MaryBeth and I'm an herbalist, Usui Reiki practitioner, Kundalini Reiki Master and soon a Crystal healer. My mission is to help people in any way I can to live healthier, chemical free lives. I want to give people an organic, healthier, gentler, safer alternative to the harsh chemicals and additives found in today's personal care & medicinal products.

feeds.title: Urban Moonshine Blog
feeds.description: Urban Moonshine is a Organic digestive bitters, herbal tonics, herbal first aid & single extracts handcrafted in Burlington, Vermont. Their mission is to bring back the traditional use of herbal remedies to modern America.

feeds.title: Apotheka Herbal Blog
feeds.description: Apotheka Herbal is a modern-day botanical dispensary, that uses an integrative and holistic approach to formulate herbal blends that work for your unique needs. Our health blog informs you about a healthy lifestyle and how herbal medicine can improve your quality of life.

feeds.title: Hackney Herbal Blog
feeds.description: Hackney Herbal is a social enterprise promoting health and wellbeing through herbs. We run creative herb-related events and activities. In this blog herb related information like its usage and medicinal importance is there. For more passionate learning about the wonders of herbs, follow us.

feeds.title: Naturimedica Blog » Herbal Medicines & Remedies
feeds.description: Naturimedica is a holistic health and wellness hub established by Joanna Sochan - Naturopath, Herbalist, Nutritionist and Reiki Practitioner. I do apply evidence-based methods where possible, I also listen to what clients say about their experiences and symptoms and rely on my clinical experience as well as traditional empirical methods of applying natural medicines, backed by intuition and insight. Its a guide to transform your life into healthy, happy and wellbeing.

feeds.title: The SkeptVet Blog » Herbs and Supplements
feeds.description: The SkeptVet blog is written to give information about the various herbs, its importance and its usage. The blogger takes a skeptical and science based look at veterinary medicine. To know more about all these, follow us.

feeds.title: The Family Herbalist
feeds.description: Natalie Vickery is an Herbalist and Educator with a degree in Natural Health Studies and Naturopathy. Natalie provides personal consultations for those who are seeking alternative health solutions and education relating to prevention and optimal health.

feeds.title: Jill's Home Remedies Blog
feeds.description: Jill is a herbalist, homeschool mom and a certified family herbalist that loves researching health and wellness and sharing with others the things she learn. Here you'll find ways to treat your family at home with natural remedies, as well as how to make herbal medicine in your very own kitchen.

feeds.title: Herbal Picnic Blog
feeds.description: A blog about natural healing, herbs, magic, folklore, beauty, remedies, recipes. Here you will find a combination of herbal wisdom, recipes & magic.

feeds.title: Australian School of Herbal Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Study herbal medicine online with the Australian School Of Herbal Medicine & receive training on herbal medicine & natural therapies. Get started today! Every plant provides a kind of remedy. Learn about herbal medicine and its cure by latest research. Herbal medicine also known as alternative cure.

feeds.title: Herbstalk Blog
feeds.description: Herbstalk is a grassroots, Boston-area herbal event that teachers people about plants. It connects people with plants and spreads awareness about herbalism. It envisions a world in which people of all backgrounds have an understanding of herbs that can be used to heal, feed and nurture us all.

feeds.title: Cocoa Fresh Ancient Herbal Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Cocoa Ancient Herbal Therapy.

feeds.title: The Happy Herbal Home Blog » Herbal Remedies

feeds.title: Full Circle Herbals Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Erin LaFaive I'm a herbalist providing herbal information to enhance your overall wellness or sleuth out an herbal remedy for a particular issue troubling you.
